description.value: V-Nam Vietnamese Cuisine is a sit-down Vietnamese restaurant on Lonsdale Avenue in central North Vancouver, serving classic dishes including fragrant pho, stir-fries, crispy spring rolls, and vermicelli bowls made from time-honored recipes. The restaurant positions itself as a community dining destination with dine-in, takeout, and online delivery options. Its location on busy Lonsdale makes it a convenient meal stop for cyclists riding the North Shore.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 68m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at v-nam.com is active and provides address (1643 Lonsdale Ave), phone (604.990.8897), and confirms an operational Vietnamese restaurant on Lonsdale in North Vancouver. Online ordering and a contact page reference takeout and catering, confirming takeout availability. No mention of bike parking, water refills, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling amenities appears anywhere on the site; the 'Top Items' footer list (Pepperoni, Swiss Mushroom, Ham & Cheese, etc.) appears to be ordering-platform template placeholder content, not actual V-Nam menu categories, so no vegetarian claim can be drawn from it.
concerns: OSM name is 'V-Nam' but the website consistently uses the fuller name 'V-Nam Vietnamese Cuisine'; OSM record should be reviewed for name completeness.
OSM record had no address or phone; both were sourced solely from the website contact page and are unconfirmed against OSM tags.

The 'Top Items' footer list on every page (Pepperoni, Swiss Mushroom, Barbeque Chicken, Ham & Cheese, etc.) appears to be default placeholder content from the VM Tech ordering platform and does not reflect V-Nam's actual Vietnamese menu — worth flagging as a data quality issue on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active Vietnamese restaurant in a central North Vancouver cycling corridor (Lonsdale Ave) with confirmed address, phone, and takeout service — a practical food stop for touring cyclists.
